announceText.description: Message: Up to 300 characters; shown as "Announcement: <message>".

announceKind.description: Style: Colour and icon of the notification.

announceSeconds.description: Time on screen: Seconds the announcement stays.

announceSend.description: Send now: Switch on to send the message to everyone; it switches itself off and the message box empties.

warnPlayer.description: Player: Players online when the panel opened; reopen the panel for players who joined since.

warnReason.description: Reason: What the player did wrong, up to 300 characters; the player reads it as written.

warnSend.description: Send now: Switch on to send the warning; it switches itself off and the form empties.

weather.description: Weather: Picking one sets it for everyone now.

freezeTime.description: Stop the clock: The time stays where it is until switched off.

blackout.description: Blackout: City lights off for everyone.
